_comment: FMS_UI (../FMS_UI). Auth0 login through the app's /login page, then one API token per company: the app swaps its Auth0 token (localStorage auth0Token) for a company token (access_token) at the auth API. The company is not in the URL. Accounts not on Auth0 (legacy login, e.g. the dev users) are sent by authPortal to the app's own POST /v1/auth2/login, which stores a company token for the default company directly; login.legacy names the claims that identify that company. Selectors: shared SortableTableColumn (th.sortable-header) and PagingControl (">" button), Kendo grids, react-loading-skeleton. companyTypeClaim is unverified until the first pg-fms login (Phase 3); a missing claim just disables page companyTypes filtering.
